title: Gun Control Act sections922(g)(1) and921(a)(20)
summary: The provisions link a possession prohibition to qualifying prior convictions and define exceptions to the predicate category.
notes:
The assigned section922(g)(1) language covers a person convicted in any court of a crime punishable by imprisonment exceeding one year and specified possession, transport, or receipt of firearms or ammunition. The definition excludes certain federal or state business-regulation offenses.

Gayle and Small read the general any-court language as domestic in this setting. The limited geographic wording of the business-offense exception creates a structural issue for the broader reading, because equivalent foreign offenses would otherwise receive different treatment. The record concerns that geographic interpretive question, not every element, exception, or later development in federal firearms law.
